notes: Interlaboratory Round Robin on one commercial carbon molecular sieve (Takeda CMS 4A). The paper reports the participating laboratories' own measured H2 isotherms (volumetric and gravimetric, 77 K and 293-301 K) as new data from the exercise, with the organisers (JRC-IE) also measuring the BET area of the same material; the only values it cites from earlier work (Schmitz et al., 1.45 wt% at 77 K, 2 MPa) are used for comparison, not as its reported data. Not a review; no retraction flag or retraction notice in record.json or the PDF text; no statement that all H2 uptake values were published before.
